intro: Can you restore the perfect view?
description:
A dreamy illustration has been sliced and turned around. How fast can you make it whole again?

You know that satisfying feeling when every little detail finally clicks into place.

This is a casual rotation puzzle where you bring each picture back to its original look by rotating the slices. Take your time to enjoy the image, or go for a speedy clear and chase a better star rating.

・Look over the sliced illustration
・Rotate each slice until the picture lines up
・Clear the stage and aim for a faster time
・Earn up to three stars based on your clear time

It is simple to start, but the more slices there are, the more your eyes and instincts get tested.

Relax, focus, and enjoy a heart-pounding little puzzle break whenever you like.

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
